name: Double Draw
description: Every successful attack draws a second shot at a random enemy within attack range, dealing damage equal to one of this unit's two attributes left unused in the encounter, picked at random.
details: The original target is a legal draw for the second shot as well.
The second shot counts as a normal attack in its own right, so it can place or consume a High Noon mark just like any other attack.
A second shot never draws a further second shot.

upgrade.summary: A missed attack still draws a second shot, just for %damage:pct%% of the damage.
